test_title: PYST 15: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

In order to __**enhancing their reputation**,__ companies are investing a lot of money in social initiatives.
solution:
The correct answer is **"enhance their reputation."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence is the incorrect use of the verb form after the preposition **"to."**
 
• Here, **"enhance"** is the base form of the verb used after the preposition** "to."**
 
• **Structure: to + base form of the verb**
 
 
• **Example: ***I want **to leave**__ the house.*
 
 
 
• The correct form of the verb in this case is the base form, not the gerund form. 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *In order to __**enhance their reputation**__, companies are investing a lot of money in social initiatives.*
